productRegression.reported: paper focus shifted the whole galaxy left before approach and return snapped from the left composition to center
productRegression.rootCause: the start anchor used a camera projection containing the context-rail view offset while the Journey quaternion solver used a canonical projection without that offset
productRegression.fix: record Journey anchors in canonical projection space and account for the renderer view offset only in final anchor diagnostics

visualCenterRegression.reported: after return, the displayed galaxy remained centered in the rail-free region instead of on the physical canvas
visualCenterRegression.rootCause: the retained hotspot rail kept a nonzero camera view offset after the Journey returned to the saved system pose
visualCenterRegression.fix: clear research-galaxy view offsets and transfer summary/reading avoidance to paper-only Journey anchors

orbitPivotRegression.reported: dragging the display galaxy rotated around a hotspot or another off-center point instead of the visible circle center
orbitPivotRegression.rootCause: system-state hotspot pivots were published as the shared camera pose and restored over the canonical overview center during Fast Refresh or scene rebuild
orbitPivotRegression.fix: bind overview Orbit to the scene canonical center, reject transient saved centers, and publish camera poses only from overview with an idle paper Journey
orbitPivotRegression.automaticResult: five full-rotation samples retained the canonical display center with maximum NDC error 4.785511361312527e-16
